decisions.reason: The requirement to raise any excavation-power metric to [A2] or above and finish training is preserved, with canonical Yukoma Onsenkyo name.
decisions.terminology_basis: Embedded reviewed proper name Yukoma Onsenkyo is satisfied.

decisions.reason: 超恢复 is a named Yukoma Onsenkyo scenario mechanic; the literal bridge-derived label 'Siêu hồi phục' lacks embedded authoritative player-facing identity evidence.
decisions.terminology_basis: Yukoma Onsenkyo proper name is canonical, but no embedded canonical is supplied for 超恢复.

decisions.reason: Top-3 race condition, two outings with the trainee Mã Nương and 500000 fan threshold are preserved with canonical Số fan and Mã Nương terminology.
decisions.terminology_basis: Embedded race.generic, progress.fans and common.world.umamusume are recognized in the current text.

decisions.proposed_text: Dùng chiến thuật “Late Surger” để thắng Kikuka Sho trong thời tiết [Mưa], đồng thời dùng chiến thuật “Front Runner” để thắng Japan Cup (Senior Class)
decisions.reason: The running styles 居中 and 领放 must use player-facing Late Surger and Front Runner rather than Vietnamese calques.
decisions.terminology_basis: Embedded common.style.late_surger and common.style.front_runner require Late Surger and Front Runner; Senior Class is already canonical.

decisions.proposed_text: Thắng Oka Sho, Yushun Himba, Shuka Sho và Japan Cup, đồng thời hoàn tất huấn luyện khi duy trì Mood “Great” trong tất cả các Cuộc đua
decisions.reason: The fixed Mood tier 绝好调 must be Great and generic 赛事 should use canonical Cuộc đua.
decisions.terminology_basis: Embedded common.state.mood/state.mood.great.text_data require Mood and Great; race.generic requires Cuộc đua.
